description: This PHP class defines a repository for OAuth clients within the OrangeHRM system. It handles fetching OAuth client entities by ID, validating clients including their secrets, and ensuring client confidentiality rules are followed. The class interacts with OAuth client entities and implements the ClientRepositoryInterface as part of an OAuth2 server implementation.

classes.name: ClientRepository
classes.description: A repository class responsible for managing OAuth client data, including retrieval by ID and validation of client credentials, within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getOAuthClientById
methods.description: Fetches an OAuthClient entity from the database by its client ID, only if it is enabled.

methods.name: getClientEntity
methods.description: Retrieves a ClientEntityInterface representation of the OAuth client specified by its identifier, if it exists.

methods.name: validateClient
methods.description: Validates an OAuth client by its ID, secret, and grant type. Ensures confidentiality and secret correctness.

methods.name: validateClientSecret
methods.description: Checks if the provided user credential matches the stored client secret using a password hasher.
